name: Umar ibn Abi Rabi'a
bio: Umar belonged to the Makhzum clan of Quraysh in Mecca in the early Umayyad period. His love poems follow encounters at the pilgrimage and in the company of women whose conversations often carry the story. He visited the court of Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan. Accounts of his death differ. Al-Zirikli records a tradition that he drowned on a naval expedition.
